content_security_policy.purpose: Stores and loads the notes and tasks, and checks the free trial and plan, on the Notetaskerator backend.

permissions.purpose: Shows the customer's name on notes and tasks, and files a note on an invoice or payment under the customer it belongs to.
Reads an invoice's number and customer so a note written on the invoice can be labelled and also shown on the customer's page.
Reads a payment's amount and customer so a note written on the payment can be labelled and also shown on the customer's page.
Does the same for payments that the Dashboard shows as a charge rather than a payment intent.
Emails a team member when a teammate assigns a task to them.
